en: The front image of the postcard depicts a historic winter scene in a city square, with several people in coats, hats, and long garments standing or walking amid deep snow. Prominent, ornate multi-story buildings surround the square. The postcard is labeled 'SUNDSVALL' and 'VÅNGÅFVAN VINTERTID,' and features handwritten text dating it to April 15, 1908. The reverse shows the address written in Swedish, a green Swedish postage stamp, and additional printed publisher details.
